script:
ct = doc.crop_type or []
for r in ct:
    if (r.crop_type or '') == 'Summer Flowers':
        doc.uses_blocks = 1
bays = doc.bay_configuration or []
ranges = doc.bed_range or []
if ranges and not bays:
    frappe.throw('Define Bay Configuration before adding beds.')
seen = {}
allbeds = []
for rg in ranges:
    fb = int(rg.from_bed or 0)
    tb = int(rg.to_bed or 0)
    if fb == 0 and tb == 0:
        continue
    if tb < fb:
        frappe.throw('Bed Configuration: To Bed ' + str(tb) + ' is less than From Bed ' + str(fb) + '.')
    L = rg.bed_length or 0
    W = rg.bed_width or 0
    if L <= 0 or W <= 0:
        frappe.throw('Bed Configuration row ' + str(fb) + '-' + str(tb) + ': Bed Length and Width must be greater than zero.')
    n = fb
    while n <= tb:
        if n in seen:
            frappe.throw('Bed number ' + str(n) + ' is used more than once in Bed Configuration.')
        baynum = 0
        for b in bays:
            sb = b.start_bed or 0
            eb = b.end_bed or 0
            if sb and eb and n >= sb and n <= eb:
                baynum = b.bay_number or 0
        if not baynum:
            frappe.throw('Bed number ' + str(n) + ' is not inside any configured bay.')
        seen[n] = 1
        allbeds.append([n, baynum, rg.variety, L, W])
        n = n + 1
doc.set('individual_beds', [])
pps = doc.plants_per_sqm or 0
total_area = 0.0
total_plants = 0
vagg = {}
bayagg = {}
for bd in allbeds:
    area = bd[3] * bd[4]
    pc = int(round(area * pps))
    doc.append('individual_beds', {'bed_number': bd[0], 'bay_number': bd[1], 'variety': bd[2], 'length_m': bd[3], 'width_m': bd[4], 'area_m2': area, 'status': 'Planted', 'plant_count': pc})
    total_area = total_area + area
    total_plants = total_plants + pc
    v = bd[2] or ''
    if v not in vagg:
        vagg[v] = [0, 0.0, 0]
    vagg[v][0] = vagg[v][0] + 1
    vagg[v][1] = vagg[v][1] + area
    vagg[v][2] = vagg[v][2] + pc
    bn = bd[1]
    if bn not in bayagg:
        bayagg[bn] = [0, 0.0, 0]
    bayagg[bn][0] = bayagg[bn][0] + 1
    bayagg[bn][1] = bayagg[bn][1] + area
    bayagg[bn][2] = bayagg[bn][2] + pc
for b in bays:
    agg = bayagg.get(b.bay_number, [0, 0.0, 0])
    b.beds = agg[0]
    b.area_m2 = agg[1]
    b.plant_count = agg[2]
doc.set('varieties_grown', [])
nvar = 0
for v in vagg:
    if v:
        nvar = nvar + 1
        doc.append('varieties_grown', {'variety': v, 'beds': vagg[v][0], 'area_m2': vagg[v][1], 'plants': vagg[v][2]})
doc.number_of_beds = len(allbeds)
doc.number_of_bays = len(bays)
doc.varieties = nvar
doc.area_planted = total_area
doc.number_of_plants = total_plants
